findings.summary: revoke uses list.remove, which scans the list, so each logout is O(n) in the number of live sessions.
purge_expired deletes list items one at a time, shifting the tail each time, so a purge can cost O(n·k); rebuilding the list in one pass would be O(n).
The store has no locking, so if purge_job runs in a scheduler thread, concurrent revoke and purge_expired calls could race, e.g. a KeyError on del self._by_token[session.token].
